events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Woodstock Festival brought together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. What's your favourite memory or performance from the legendary event?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. He would have been 91 this year. His music and charisma continue to inspire generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, an influential rapper and actor, was tragically shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Today, we remember the legendary Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite Tupac lyric or song?

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled guitar genius, Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year. His innovative sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Jimi Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the legendary cover to timeless tracks, it's a masterpiece. Which song is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting with The Pretenders have left an indelible mark on rock music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the outspoken frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that continues to inspire and resonate globally. What does this powerful anthem mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: 25 Years of iPod
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's been 25 years since Apple launched the first iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! Happy James Bond Day to all 007 fans. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix and raw sound still captivate. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80 this year. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
